item.title: Pick the Best Ten Seconds

turns.text: Trim this to the best 10 seconds. You pick the part.

item.tests: Tests autonomous highlight selection and an accurate contiguous trim of the supplied video rather than a generated replacement.

answer_sheet.Sound: Keep the original sound from the selected section.
answer_sheet.Crop, text, or other styling: Keep the original framing; no added text or effects.

must_haves: One playable video lasts 10 seconds, within one frame of tolerance.
The output is one continuous excerpt from jet-30s.mp4, with the source framing and playback speed preserved.
The chosen excerpt contains a salient moment of jet action or cockpit interaction, rather than mostly inactive footage.
Original sound from the selected interval remains synchronized; no replacement music, narration, or captions are added.

dialog.agent:
I can’t preview or trim the attached video with the connected tools—they regenerate footage rather than make a simple cut. So I can’t honestly pick the best 10 seconds or return a trimmed file here.

For a quick fallback, use **00:10–00:20**, though I haven’t verified that it’s the strongest section.
dialog.why: It explicitly says the connected tools cannot preview or trim the video or return a trimmed file. The unverified timestamp suggestion is a fallback, not a finished result.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the 10-second edit because your account has **insufficient credits**, even with the free-plan model at 480p. Nothing was generated or charged.

Free-plan settings still require generation credits. An exact 00:10–00:20 trim in a regular video editor would avoid that cost.
